name: Window Counter
description: Counts frame windows of a macro by replaying it in-game and exports nandl.json for the HyperClick trainer. Android build.

max-shift.name: Max window (ticks per side)
max-shift.description: How far (in ticks, 240 TPS) each input is shifted left and right while looking for its window. Windows wider than this are capped.

horizon.name: Survive after input (ticks)
horizon.description: A shifted input counts as passing if the player stays alive this many ticks after it.

tick-offset.name: Input tick offset (calibration)
tick-offset.description: Shifts when macro inputs are injected relative to the game tick counter. If the self-test says the macro desyncs, try -1 or 1.

budget-ms.name: Work per frame (ms)
budget-ms.description: How long the counter simulates each rendered frame. Higher = faster counting but a choppier screen.
